_note: Match rules (CombatWorld). friendlyFire: the share of damage that would hurt an enemy that hurts a teammate instead, per kind of harm: 1 = all of it, as in Helldivers 2 (the default everywhere); 0 = teammates are safe. self: your own blasts. melee hits allies fully or not at all (0 or 1). Bots check their line of fire and blast radius before they shoot, throw or call a strike (docs/GAMEPLAY_PLAN.md).
